name: until-the-end
description: Until The End — jeu pixel art de stratégie et de minage (web + Android)

scripts.apk: npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.aab: npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.ios: npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.ipa: npx cap sync ios && cd ios/App && xcodebuild -project App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Release -destination generic/platform=iOS -archivePath build/UntilTheEnd.xcarchive -allowProvisioningUpdates archive
